checked_conclusions: Captured camera remains stable across target callbacks; scene and batches are reloaded where the concrete native path does so.

Job branch requires sync disabled and both actual counts>50; no serial substitution for missing job backend. Callback uses stored batch mode at execution, and all queued stack job records are waited before leaving.
Diagnostic cleanup reloads current singleton and assigns X. Scope begins after diagnostic installation, matching native cleanup lifetime; host backend failures before that point stop explicitly.
Pure-virtual scene and material operations remain required and explicitly incomplete; real target COM errors continue through later stages and are reported after completed orchestration.
One shared CompiledMaterialEffect carries full identity/metadata/fallback across passes. Root descriptor fields update before later compilation failure; metadata reads fail when absent.

Installed mesh glue acquires cached lowercase error.tga before consuming the effect serial, and clone/pass owners retain the same wrapper. LogicalTexture still borrows its underlying COM, so physical owner must outlive use.
Nonnull COM triggers texture serial consumption before GetLevelDesc; later host description failure does not roll back counter. Existing wrapper recreation never consumes another serial.
limits: Read-only source and instruction/byte review; no new functional tests or live-game execution performed.
Native allocator/SEH/global-renderer replacement and arbitrary virtual overrides remain outside the typed orchestration fragment.
Fallback wrapper identity is retained; full native texture-cache and COM ownership are not inferred from shared_ptr<LogicalTexture>.
Existing primary Win32 build and installed-mesh probe results were provided by integrator, not rerun in this review.
